title: wholesome steam kenyan greens pilaf
description: savory, crisp, light kenyan dish featuring paprika, mushimono-steam, flexitarian-friendly. perfect for weeknights or sunday lunch.
instructions: cook the rice in a large saucepan with 250ml of chicken broth, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
while the rice cooks, heat 2 tbsp of garlic oil in a pan over medium heat, add 1 tsp of ginger powder and 2 tsp of paprika, sauté for 1 minute.
add 250g of green beans and 200g of kale to the pan, sauté for 3 minutes until tender.
stir in 1 tsp of black pepper, then combine with cooked rice.
transfer the rice mixture to a steamer basket and steam for 10 minutes.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
